svg.title: Heartbeat, telemetry, and health publishers connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for Heartbeat, telemetry, and health publishers.

g.text: Heartbeat, telemetry, and health publishers connections

a.xlink:title: Enrollment and device lifecycle state. Retains enrolled devices across connectivity loss and separates durable enrollment, current state, health, supervisor state, and recovery history.
Heartbeat, telemetry, and health publishers. Publish fresh runtime signals used to derive Online, Offline, Stale, Agent stopped, and Remote access not ready states.
Lite node agent. Connects to NATS, publishes heartbeat/telemetry/health, handles device commands, and reconnects after outages.
a.text: Server host or joined device · PM2

a.xlink:title: NATS / JetStream. Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.
